games.name: SCP: Site-76: Prison Anomalies
games.desc:
👁️ Welcome to Site-76, a SCP inspired secret prison compound responsible for containing both inmates and SCPs! Understaffed and wild, breakouts are a regular occurrence. 

👮 Play as a Foundation member laboring to keep the facility functional and arrest delinquents, a prisoner seeking to escape, or contain SCPs in this chaotic sandbox brawl!

💣Start riots, disguise as other players, release (or play as!) SCPs to cause mayhem, take up contracts to assassinate players, begin heists to steal strange objects for a mysterious organization and destroy foundation machinery to impede their jobs!

☢️Remember, if the situation gets out of control, then the facility itself may be sacrificed in an explosion of nuclear proportions!

Type /name for custom names to help with roleplay immersion
4 Foundation Staff are needed for stats to save in VIP servers.

games.name: Pomerania Roads
games.desc:
🎮 Pomerania Roads is an incredible driving experience that combines the stunning scenery of Gdańsk Pomerania with highly detailed models of various vehicles, from fast and modern to common and classic cars, together with mechanics that let you earn achievements and in-game upgrades.

💵 In the game, you can play and earn money as a mail deliverer or a store stocker. You may spend time roleplaying and socializing with people, join in various events, or just drive and explore the beautiful scenery of Polish villages.

📢 If you are looking to get updates on a regular basis, we suggest that you join our community server. Please report to our staff team any bugs, exploiters, or issues that you come across.

📱 Although we work for accessibility, please be aware that only a limited number of game features are currently supported on mobile devices.
